mapper.select: select id, account_id, title, content, category, priority, deadline, done, source_type, source_id, create_time, update_time from study_plan_task where account_id = #{accountId} order by done asc, (deadline is null) asc, deadline asc, create_time desc
select id, account_id, title, content, category, priority, deadline, done, source_type, source_id, create_time, update_time from study_plan_task where id = #{id} and account_id = #{accountId} limit 1

select id, account_id, title, content, category, priority, deadline, done, source_type, source_id, create_time, update_time from study_plan_task where account_id = #{accountId} and source_type = #{sourceType} and source_id = #{sourceId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into study_plan_task (account_id, title, content, category, priority, deadline, done, source_type, source_id) values (#{accountId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{category}, #{priority}, #{deadline}, #{done}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId})
mapper.update: update study_plan_task set title = #{title}, content = #{content}, category = #{category}, priority = #{priority}, deadline = #{deadline}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and account_id = #{accountId} and source_type = 'manual'
